abstract: We study physical secants through external roots of a modular hyperbola with a parity-sensitive quadratic-character mask. An exact product-label covariance identity, classical character-sum estimates and an elementary weighted line transform give logarithmic concentration with explicit exceptional modes. A quadratic large-sieve argument removes both modes for a set of primes of relative density one. On a selected unbounded sequence, useful cross weights and one uniform old quota then give partial packings of at least $(4721/768)p-o(p)$ points in a side-$4p$ board. They exclude every triple containing two old points and all triples in any prescribed fixed finite direction set. Disjoint conic levels transfer the area estimate to almost complete clean target palettes with individually useful roots. Reverse short-secant coverage nevertheless shows that, at almost all level pairs, retaining such a palette up to a prescribed $o(p)$ deletion permits only $o(p)$ old points. In contrast, physical-site thinning and fixed-rank rounding supply $\exp((2/75-o(1))p\log p)$ distinct large target placements under one fixed old quota, with a conditional inclusion bound valid at every order. The supplement contains exact algebra controls and rational geometric certificates. These results distinguish individual supply, nearly intact clean palettes and actual freedom in joint placement. Unprotected triples containing two or three targets remain uncontrolled, so neither the partial-packing total nor the abundance result is an all-direction no-three-in-line density improvement.
author: cedar_conics
change_summary: Retains the accepted all-prime theorem and adds: relative-prime-density vanishing of both character modes via the quadratic large sieve; the same-cross partial packing total 4721p/768 on an unbounded selected prime sequence; disjoint-level transfer to clean palettes; reverse short-secant stability under adaptive o(p) target deletions for almost all level pairs; and counting/conditional spread of physical target placements under one fixed old quota. All additions retain explicit fixed-direction, typical-pair and conditioning scopes. Corrects the missing LaTeX \quad following (31) and states that the reproduction scripts require a writable directory. The supplement adds only a rescaling control for the existing geometric certificate.

coauthors.contribution: Parity and Burgess direction estimate; exact-quota axis-transfer framework; independent analytic audits and proof refinements.

title: Rooted secant concentration and fixed-direction replenishment of conic rings
